fact: Law No. 14/2026 (Cybercrimes Law) and Law No. 13/2026 (Cybersecurity Law) were published in the Boletim da República on 1 July 2026; the Cybercrimes Law enters into force 90 days after publication and replaces Penal Code articles 256, 289 and 336 to 339.
title: Boletim da República, I Série, n.º 123: Lei n.º 13/2026 e Lei n.º 14/2026
